Hi, Joice. Do you have any questions about the report?
Yes, I have some. How many schools are in the program?
Four hundred schools, in six states.
And how much time does a teacher need to learn the platform?
Not much. About thirty minutes, with the short videos.
Good. Do we have any data about the small schools?
We have some, but not enough. That is a real problem.
I think the number of small schools is very big in Brazil.
You are right. How many are there, more or less?
I do not have the exact number, but I can send it tomorrow.

Good morning. Here are the numbers of the program, in one minute. We work with four hundred schools, in six states. About two thousand teachers use the platform every week. A teacher needs about thirty minutes to learn the platform, so not much time. We have some data about the big schools, but we do not have enough data about the small ones. If you have any question about the numbers, please write to me before the meeting. Thank you.

Hi, this is a short message about the November event. How many people can go? Only two people from each group, so please decide this week. How much time do you have for your presentation? Three minutes, and not one minute more. We have some rooms for small sessions, and any group can ask for one. If you need any help with the material, write to the office. See you soon.

Joice opens the report with the numbers of the year. She reads how many schools are in the program. She sees that there is not enough data about small schools. She writes one question about the small schools. She sends the question to the team before the meeting.
